story.title: New HIV vaccine shows unprecedented success in preclinical study

draft:
A new HIV vaccine has shown nearly 100% protection in preclinical trials. 
I've been following the development of HIV vaccines for years, and this is a major breakthrough. 
The use of a specific molecule to target and destroy infected cells is key. 
What implications do you think this will have for future vaccine development?
#HIVresearch #vaccinedevelopment #medicaltech
